metrics.name: finding_precision
metrics.definition: Share of reported non-duplicate findings that uniquely match a labelled expected finding.
metrics.numerator: Uniquely matched reported findings.
metrics.denominator: Reported non-duplicate findings eligible for label matching.
metrics.population: Completed validation reviews with adjudicated labels.

metrics.name: finding_recall
metrics.definition: Share of labelled expected findings found at least once by the review.
metrics.numerator: Labelled expected findings with a unique matching report.
metrics.denominator: Labelled expected findings in positive cases.
metrics.population: Positive validation cases with completed reviews.

metrics.name: actionable_finding_rate
metrics.definition: Share of evaluated findings for which the reviewer can identify a concrete next action.
metrics.numerator: Evaluated findings marked actionable by the reviewer.

metrics.name: accepted_finding_rate
metrics.definition: Share of evaluated findings accepted as valid and useful by a reviewer.
metrics.numerator: Findings with outcome accepted.
metrics.denominator: Findings with accepted, rejected, needs_more_context, or abstained outcomes.

metrics.name: rejected_finding_rate
metrics.definition: Share of evaluated findings explicitly rejected by a reviewer.
metrics.numerator: Findings with outcome rejected.
metrics.denominator: Findings with accepted, rejected, needs_more_context, or abstained outcomes.

metrics.name: duplicate_rate
metrics.definition: Share of reported findings adjudicated as duplicates of another finding in the same review.
metrics.numerator: Findings with a valid duplicate-of relationship.
exclusions: suppressed findings never presented to the reviewer

metrics.name: false_positive_rate
metrics.definition: Share of clean negative cases where at least one finding is presented.
metrics.numerator: Clean cases with one or more presented findings.

metrics.name: severity_usefulness
metrics.definition: Share of severity assessments the reviewer considers useful for prioritization.
metrics.numerator: Evaluated findings with useful severity assessment.

metrics.name: anchor_usefulness
metrics.definition: Share of finding anchors that let the reviewer identify the affected code without searching elsewhere.
metrics.numerator: Evaluated findings with a useful file and line anchor.

metrics.name: explanation_usefulness
metrics.definition: Share of finding explanations sufficient for the reviewer to understand the claimed problem.
metrics.numerator: Evaluated findings with a useful explanation.

metrics.name: evidence_usefulness
metrics.definition: Share of finding evidence assessments that help the reviewer decide validity.
metrics.numerator: Evaluated findings with useful evidence.

metrics.name: time_to_understand_finding
metrics.definition: Mean elapsed time from opening a finding until the reviewer records understanding.
metrics.numerator: Sum of measured understanding durations.
metrics.denominator: Findings with a completed understanding timestamp.

metrics.name: time_to_resolve_finding
metrics.definition: Mean elapsed time from opening a finding to its final reviewer outcome.
metrics.numerator: Sum of measured finding-resolution durations.
metrics.denominator: Findings with a final evaluated outcome and valid timing.

metrics.name: time_to_first_useful_finding
metrics.definition: Mean elapsed review time until the first finding later accepted as useful.
metrics.numerator: Sum of time-to-first-accepted-finding durations.
metrics.denominator: Reviews containing at least one accepted finding and valid timing.

metrics.name: proposal_eligibility_rate
metrics.definition: Share of evaluated findings that satisfy the documented proposal eligibility policy.
metrics.numerator: Findings classified proposal eligible.
metrics.denominator: Findings evaluated by the eligibility policy.
metrics.population: Completed findings with immutable context identity.

metrics.name: proposal_generation_success
metrics.definition: Share of eligible proposal requests producing accepted structured output.
metrics.numerator: Eligible requests producing a structured proposal.

metrics.name: patch_parse_success
metrics.definition: Share of generated structured proposals whose patch parses successfully.
metrics.numerator: Generated proposals with a parsed patch.

metrics.name: patch_validation_success
metrics.definition: Share of explicitly validated parsed patches passing the configured isolated validation scope.
metrics.numerator: Validation attempts with a passed result.
metrics.population: Parsed patches explicitly approved for validation.

metrics.name: targeted_test_success
metrics.definition: Share of completed targeted-test executions that pass.
metrics.numerator: Targeted-test executions with passed status.
metrics.denominator: Targeted-test executions with passed or failed status.
metrics.population: Validated proposals whose policy selected targeted tests.

metrics.name: user_approval_rate
metrics.definition: Share of human-evaluated proposals explicitly approved by the reviewer.
metrics.numerator: Proposals with accepted outcome.
metrics.denominator: Proposals with accepted, rejected, needs_more_context, needs_regeneration, or abstained outcomes.

metrics.name: user_rejection_rate
metrics.definition: Share of human-evaluated proposals explicitly rejected by the reviewer.
metrics.numerator: Proposals with rejected outcome.
metrics.denominator: Proposals with accepted, rejected, needs_more_context, needs_regeneration, or abstained outcomes.

metrics.name: regeneration_rate
metrics.definition: Share of evaluated generated proposals for which the reviewer requests regeneration.
metrics.numerator: Generated proposals with needs_regeneration outcome.

metrics.name: apply_conflict_rate
metrics.definition: Share of explicitly authorized apply attempts that fail due to repository-state or patch conflicts.
metrics.numerator: Apply attempts ending in a conflict status.
metrics.population: Approved proposals with an apply attempt.

metrics.name: revert_rate
metrics.definition: Share of successfully applied proposals subsequently reverted by an explicit user action.
metrics.numerator: Applied proposals explicitly reverted.
metrics.denominator: Successfully applied proposals with observable follow-up.

metrics.name: regression_rate
metrics.definition: Share of accepted fixes with an observed regression under the declared validation or follow-up policy.
metrics.numerator: Accepted fixes with an observed regression.
metrics.denominator: Accepted fixes with a completed regression assessment.
metrics.population: Accepted fixes with targeted, full-suite, or bounded follow-up evidence.

metrics.name: time_to_accepted_fix
metrics.definition: Mean elapsed time from proposal request to explicit user acceptance.
metrics.numerator: Sum of elapsed durations for accepted fixes.

metrics.name: time_saved_vs_manual_correction
metrics.definition: Mean paired manual baseline duration minus CodeAtlas duration for accepted fixes.
metrics.numerator: Sum of paired manual-duration minus tool-duration differences.
metrics.denominator: Accepted fixes with a predeclared comparable manual baseline.
metrics.population: Paired correction tasks completed under the same scope and validation policy.
exclusions: missing or invalid negative duration inputs

metrics.name: review_completion_rate
metrics.definition: Share of admitted review runs that complete with a terminal completed result.
metrics.numerator: Admitted reviews with completed status.

metrics.name: timeout_rate
metrics.definition: Share of admitted operations ending with timed_out status.
metrics.numerator: Admitted operations ending timed_out.
metrics.denominator: Admitted operations with a terminal result.
metrics.population: Review, provider, validation, and test operations reported separately by operation type.

metrics.name: cancellation_rate
metrics.definition: Share of admitted runs ending with an explicit cancelled status.
metrics.numerator: Admitted runs ending cancelled.
metrics.denominator: Admitted runs with a terminal result.
metrics.population: Review and repair runs, reported separately.
exclusions: stale-run cancellation reported separately when required

metrics.name: provider_failure_rate
metrics.definition: Share of live provider attempts ending in a stable provider failure.
metrics.numerator: Provider attempts ending failed, timed_out, rate_limited, or malformed.

metrics.name: recovery_correctness
metrics.definition: Share of interrupted operations recovered to their expected fail-closed durable state.
metrics.numerator: Interrupted operations meeting all scenario-specific recovery assertions.
metrics.population: Queued, provider-generation, validation, and revert interruption exercises.
exclusions: scenario unavailable with a recorded capability reason

metrics.name: stale_run_correctness
metrics.definition: Share of stale-run exercises where stale output is cancelled or rejected and never presented as current.
metrics.numerator: Stale-run exercises satisfying every identity and presentation assertion.

metrics.name: github_delivery_correctness
metrics.definition: Share of eligible delivery exercises with the expected bounded comment, check-run, and artifact state.
metrics.numerator: Delivery exercises satisfying identity, deduplication, update, redaction, and bounds assertions.
metrics.population: Mocked and hosted GitHub evidence reported separately.

metrics.name: extension_startup_success
metrics.definition: Share of explicit extension startup attempts reaching validated CodeAtlas health within the deadline.
metrics.numerator: Startup attempts reaching matching healthy service identity.
metrics.denominator: Explicit managed startup attempts with prerequisites available.
metrics.population: Controlled-beta extension sessions by host version and operating system.

metrics.name: service_crash_recovery
metrics.definition: Share of controlled service crashes that restart with valid ownership, persistence, and fail-closed interrupted state.
metrics.numerator: Crash exercises satisfying ownership, persistence, and recovery assertions.

metrics.name: orphaned_process_rate
metrics.definition: Share of owned child-process lifecycle exercises leaving a verified live orphan after cleanup.
metrics.numerator: Exercises with a verified orphaned owned process.
metrics.denominator: Exercises that spawned an owned child process.
metrics.population: Managed service startup, restart, timeout, crash, and deactivation exercises.
exclusions: external processes never owned by CodeAtlas

metrics.name: secret_redaction_success
metrics.definition: Share of seeded secret-bearing outputs whose persisted and presented forms contain no seeded secret.
metrics.numerator: Secret-seeding exercises with complete redaction across all inspected surfaces.
metrics.population: Logs, diagnostics, artifacts, findings, provider output, and packages.
exclusions: patterns outside the declared scanner corpus, documented separately

metrics.name: unsafe_command_rejection
metrics.definition: Share of disallowed command requests rejected before process execution.
metrics.numerator: Disallowed command requests rejected with zero process starts.

metrics.name: unauthorized_apply_rejection
metrics.definition: Share of apply requests lacking valid bound authorization rejected without workspace mutation.
metrics.numerator: Unauthorized apply requests rejected with zero workspace mutation.
metrics.population: Missing, stale, mismatched, and cross-scope approval-token cases.

metrics.name: cross_repository_isolation
metrics.definition: Share of cross-repository access attempts rejected without exposing records or mutating either repository.
metrics.numerator: Cross-repository attempts safely rejected.
metrics.population: Read, proposal, validation, apply, revert, artifact, and persistence scope cases.

metrics.name: stale_proposal_rejection
metrics.definition: Share of stale proposal apply or validation attempts rejected before mutation or execution.
metrics.numerator: Stale proposal attempts safely rejected.
metrics.population: Revision, context, policy, and validation-evidence mismatch cases.

metrics.name: token_leakage_rate
metrics.definition: Share of seeded approval or credential tokens found in prohibited persisted or presented surfaces.
metrics.numerator: Exercises where a seeded token is observed on any prohibited surface.
metrics.denominator: Token-seeding exercises with all required surfaces inspected.
metrics.population: Approval, provider, GitHub, extension, logs, artifacts, and persistence cases.
exclusions: in-memory comparison at the authorization boundary

metrics.name: unexpected_workspace_mutation_rate
metrics.definition: Share of read-only, rejected, dry-run, cancelled, or recovery exercises that unexpectedly change repository bytes or Git state.
metrics.numerator: Exercises with an unexpected workspace or Git-state mutation.
metrics.denominator: Exercises that declare zero mutation authority.
metrics.population: Collection, review, dry-run, rejection, cancellation, and recovery cases.
exclusions: explicitly confirmed apply and revert operations
